observation_summary: Numeric overflow errors were reported as generic parsing exceptions, preventing calling applications from programmatically distinguishing between syntax errors and type coercion failures.
reasoning_summary: The bug was identified as a design flaw where numeric overflow errors during coercion were being reported as generic JsonParseExceptions. The fix involved introducing a more specific exception type, InputCoercionException, which provides better metadata (such as the target type and input token type) to the calling application. The code changes updated the error reporting methods in ParserBase and ParserMinimalBase to utilize this new exception type instead of the generic _reportError method, allowing for better error handling and differentiation between parsing errors and type mismatch/coercion errors.
